note: Truth for scripts/crs_bench.py (#1471). Ids, checklist field names and standard clause ids only - no document text. A label is added only from a recorded hand check; the source of each is named.
counting_rule: wrong verdicts: a finding the code decided (COMPLIANT or NON_COMPLIANT) that a truth 'wrong' matcher names (the replay column also counts 'wrong_replay'; a saved run keeps the rows it wrote). Hard stop above 0.
untrue lines / irrelevant lines: findings a truth matcher names, counted once per finding (one finding = one CRS line).
checklist decided: datasheet_check findings COMPLIANT or NON_COMPLIANT, of all datasheet_check findings; a Pass on a deferred value (D2) is not credited as a decision.

standard rules decided: distinct requirement_ids whose finding is COMPLIANT or NON_COMPLIANT, of the rules that apply as the run states them (requirement_split: checked + applies_not_checked, the headline boundary); when a run has no split, of distinct requirement_ids not sent to NOT_IN_DOCUMENT_SCOPE.

verified-quote rate: findings carrying a contractor quote and page whose quote is found, whitespace- and case-folded, in that page's stored text. The gate counts the quotes NOT found (a rise is red); a fall in found quotes because rows were rightly removed is not a loss.
pages read: ledger pages not listed in pages_not_read_into_fields, of ledger pages (the code's current meaning of 'read').
kind recognised: the kind the code would route on (today: any equipment type = datasheet) equals the truth kind.

pass on a contractor-deferred value (D2): COMPLIANT findings whose wording says 'By Contractor' or 'TBA'. Owner decision D2: these are Query. Shown on its own row, gated (a rise is red), not credited as decided, not yet counted as wrong verdicts.
